- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/20 (Sat) 04:48
- [FACT] User is interested in Swedish cuisine.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Swedish meatballs are an iconic dish served with cream sauce, mashed potatoes, and lingonberry jam.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Swedish meatballs can be found at Pelikan, Meatballs for the People, or Rosendals Trädgård in Stockholm.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Gravlax is a dish of cured salmon usually served as an appetizer.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Gravlax can be found at Nystekt Strömming, Östermalms Saluhall, or Wedholms Fisk in Stockholm.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Smörgåsbord is a traditional buffet-style meal featuring a variety of dishes such as pickled herring, cold cuts, and cheeses.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Smörgåsbord can be found at Södermalm's Kvarnen, the Grand Hôtel's Veranda, or T/Bar in Stockholm.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Toast Skagen is a dish of shrimp, mayonnaise, and dill served on a slice of bread.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Toast Skagen can be found at Restaurang AG, Sturehof, or Krog Karl Johans Torg in Stockholm.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Falukorv is a type of Swedish sausage often served as a main dish with mashed potatoes and lingonberry jam.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Falukorv can be found at Tranan, Tradition Gastrobar, or Pane Vino in Stockholm.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Raggmunk is a pancake-like dish made with grated potatoes.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Raggmunk can be found at Bakfickan, Tennstopet, or Hasselbacken in Stockholm.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Janssons Frestelse is a casserole dish made with potatoes, cream, onions, and anchovies.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Janssons Frestelse can be found at Tysta Mari, Prinsen, or Fem små hus in Stockholm.
- [USER] User is craving something sweet.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Kanelbullar (cinnamon buns) are a staple in Sweden and can be found in almost every bakery in Stockholm.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Popular spots for Kanelbullar include Fabrique, Bullar och Bröd, or Café Saturnus.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Kladdkaka is a rich and gooey chocolate cake beloved in Sweden.
